primary_task: Use the GitHub CLI (gh) to query and manipulate issues, PRs, discussions and repo contents.

requirements.name: gh
requirements.evidence: Patterns for invoking the GitHub CLI (gh)

requirements.name: GitHub
requirements.evidence: gh auth status prints the active host(s), user
requirements.check: gh auth status ; gh api user --jq .login ; [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]
requirements.observed: gh auth status reports GH_TOKEN invalid, but gh api user returns a login; GH_TOKEN set

notes: gh auth status says token invalid (proxy-injected auth), yet authenticated API calls succeed via the proxy.
